primaryKey.description: True if index is the primary key for the table.

indexCols.description: Comma separated list of index col definitions (e.g. includes descending modifier).

indexType.description: Index type (e.g. btree, gin, gist, etc.)

filterSql.description: Partial index filter sql, if any

indexSize.description:
Size of the index in pretty format. Example: 40 kB.
Currently only supported for postgres datastore.
